scope: One conditional-compilation C++ source, one explicitly selected backend/action per driver invocation. Manufactured tensors only: no case initialization, geometry, boundary fit, time integration or physical acceptance. No legacy-only build/run option or automatic configuration matrix.
CPU_actual_path: Include the actual production JSphCpu.cpp in the helper translation unit; link the new closed upl_c08_artstress_DebugCPU_r1 objects excluding main.obj and JSphCpu.obj. Actual PrepareArtificialStress covers raw total stress, epsilon zero, preload clear and the legacy branch. A direct call to the real static ComputeArtificialStressArray additionally checks the member/static legacy wiring bytewise. No copied spectral algorithm.
GPU_actual_path: Compile the same C++ source with _WITHGPU, link new closed upl_c08_artstress_Debug_r1 objects excluding main.obj. Use public cusph::CteInteractionUp with zero-initialized StCteInteraction and explicit epsilon, public ComputeArtificialStress with default NULL pore pointer for legacy, and real JSphGpu::PrepareArtificialStress for raw/epsilon0/preload clear. Only borrowed device input/scratch pointers; detach before base destruction. One future compute-sanitizer12.3 target invocation, no preceding direct run.
analytic_inputs: Six fixed cases: negative diagonal compression; one tensile principal direction; x-z rotated tensor with eigenvalues +4096,-4096,-2048 Pa and a known 45-degree eigenvector; effective stress -4096I with pore pressure -8192 Pa giving total +4096I; zero stress; and an excluded floating marker with tensile input. Epsilon is manufactured dyadic0.25, legacy density1024 kg/m3. These are not the case08 density or geometry. References are declared exact principal spectra/directions, not another Jacobi implementation.
modes_and_counts: All six cases in raw, legacy, epsilon0 and preload_clear: 24 tensor rows /144 scalar rows, four tail checks. Raw reference is -epsilon times the analytic positive spectral tensor in Pa; legacy reference uses effective stress and divides its declared raw tensor by1024^2. Negative pore pressure changes raw total-stress response but not legacy effective-stress response. Preload clear and epsilon0 require numerical zero, as do compression/zero/floating cases.
budget: For each component use32*FLT_EPSILON*max(1,maxabs(tensor_input)) Pa; tensor_input is total stress for raw, effective stress for legacy. Divide this budget by1024^2 for the legacy units. The sole rotated input requires one nontrivial Jacobi plane rotation;32 float eps allows rounding of its trig/rotation/reconstruction operations without a physical-pressure tolerance. No new5Pa, trajectory, conservation or contact gate is introduced. Zero requirements remain exact.
state_and_storage: Every call checks unchanged code, physical velocity/legacy density, effective stress and pore-pressure arrays and a seventh scratch tail marker. Only the six AS outputs may change. The fixture does not claim preservation of unallocated physical states or prove real force-stage scheduling. CPU and GPU are separately checked against the same analytic cases; no new cross-backend0ULP requirement.
pair_limitation: A true two-particle CPU/GPU force fixture needs the full cell/force parameter setup and exceeds the bounded spectral/phase tool. It is explicitly not implemented; no copied J pair formula is presented as a test. Root source review and the separately planned ASoff11-frame /ASon0.3s tests remain separate evidence, not already completed here.
legacy_limitation: The legacy mode is the current real normalized-R function versus an analytic reference, with CPU static/member wiring equality. It is not an old/new runtime bit comparison. No extra legacy helper or old-object execution is provided.

Keep /Od /MTd /fp:precise and MSVC14.36. Actual Popen/Win32 calls are sealed before completion checks. Fresh outputs/logs refuse overwrite and failures have no automatic retry. Four closed runtime companions come from retained component folders, not mutable canonical folders.
